instructions: Seed these areas once. Suggested branches are examples, not mandatory precreated folders. Resolve references by seed_key, never by a mutable display name.

areas.name: Inner Life & Identity
areas.description: Beliefs, values, feelings, motivation, questions, and changing self-understanding.

areas.name: Health & Care
areas.description: Physical and mental health, everyday care, and observations about what helps.

areas.name: Relationships & Social Life
areas.description: Connection, social experiences, meeting people, dating, and the context around relationships.

areas.name: Roots & Personal History
areas.description: Family, culture, places of origin, formative experiences, and things worth remembering.

areas.name: Learning & Academia
areas.description: The wider academic picture, without replacing the school-note workspace.

areas.name: Career & Working Life
areas.description: Work, possibilities, skills, connections, and what a meaningful working life might involve.

areas.name: Making & Creative Practice
areas.description: Original work, fragments, projects, revisions, and experiments without a required audience.

areas.name: Arts, Culture & Taste
areas.description: Encountering and appreciating work, developing taste, and understanding what moves you.

areas.name: Money & Independence
areas.description: Financial context, practical records, major decisions, security, and the meaning of enough.

areas.name: Home & Everyday Life
areas.description: The practical and material setting of ordinary life.

areas.name: Places, Travel & Experiences
areas.description: Anticipation, places, experiences, practical trip context, and reflections afterward.

areas.name: Play & Curiosity
areas.description: Interests and experiments allowed to exist without an achievement goal.

areas.name: Community & Contribution
areas.description: Belonging, volunteering, causes, responsibility, and ways to contribute.

areas.name: Internet Bible
areas.description: Things encountered online, saved with context and a clear distinction between links and local content.
